en.measure_into.filled: Measured {value}. Pick a second item to measure between the two, or press Enter to keep it.
en.measure_into.no_field: Measure Into Value writes into a value of an open dialog: open a dialog with a value first.
en.measure_into.none: Nothing to measure between these two. Pick again.
en.measure_into.second: Pick a second item to measure the distance or angle to it.
en.measure_into.start: Measure Into Value: pick an edge, a round face or a point. A second pick measures between the two. Enter keeps the value, Esc puts the old one back.
